approved_scope: Phase 2 study only, not active formal; Phase 3 remains paused.
description: Max three independent IC variable C branches. Per branch 0..1.5 pF, Q50, all connection positions allowed, inherited from RF-F002.
validation_notes: No exact layout required; up to three branches, shunt, bridge or series. Circuit topology and connection locations are constant across all six settings, only C values are tunable. 0 pF series state must be treated as open. Explicit opt-in and independent validation required.
